artifact.label: RNA-seq (transcript-level check on the cut, held at a store location, not embedded)
artifact.title: RNA-seq expression, A549 MYC-inducible line, 72h timepoint
artifact.description: RNA-seq expression (TPM), induced (72h, 1ug/mL doxycycline) and uninduced samples, same passage as the western blot. 19,046 genes quantified, MYC among them. Synthetic example.

objects.name: rest
objects.label: Addressing method: query by gene symbol
objects.description: TPM for the induced and uninduced samples, one value pair per gene.
objects.addressing_method: gene=<HGNC symbol>&col=<TPM_relative|TPM_raw>. TPM_relative is induced-sample TPM divided by uninduced-sample TPM; TPM_raw is the induced-sample value alone.
